implementation: Acquire the bounded MCU input row once. SSSE3/SSE2 widens four RGBA8 pixels, repeats alpha, evaluates exact encoded-space flattening with unsigned16-bit products and exact divide255, then packs RGB. Unaligned loads/stores and scalar tails are bounded. Scalar fallback,16-bit normalization and caller RGB samples remain unchanged. No new heap/frame/cache owner; same8-KiB fixed/work limits and terminal admission/cancellation/lifetime behavior.
